text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Good job, trainer! You are working hard 
every day.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
By the way… it's finally that time of year 
again!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the annual "Summer 
Camp" at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
This is a different kind of training, 
where you stay overnight at the facility…

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure your horse girl will grow even 
more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
… So please make sure she's in good shape 
for the summer camp in July.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp goes by so fast! There's no 
time to take a "break".

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Good reply! Hehe… I'm looking forward to 
it… Summer camp ♪

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course, practice comes first, but…

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes it's nice to take a break and 
"go out" to the beach!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will refresh your horse girl 
and relieve her fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
It's only a short two months from July to 
August, but…

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Please spend a fruitful "summer camp" with 
your horse girl.
Tazuna told me about the "summer camp"!

I should pay attention to <chrname>'s condition and 
energy to prepare for the camp…

It starts in two turns, in the first half 
of July, so we'd better start preparing 
now.
